timeBasis: UTC; directory dates are evidence identifiers
mission: Complete private admin use of Max Booster across all twelve domains; public rollout deferred

source.note: Base checkout plus PR211 overlays. SHA256 values identify the exact files tested; the local HEAD alone does not identify the overlay.

findings.before: Administrator with role=admin, tier=free and status=none received403 for both Pro and Enterprise API key creation.
findings.after: Trusted session administrators can create every API key tier without a public plan. Ordinary tier rules, account suspension and shared MFA/session authority remain enforced.
realWorkflow: Create Pro and Enterprise keys with server-derived owner despite submitted foreign userId
Verify stored SHA256 key hash, tier limit and active state in SQL
List owned keys without plaintext or hash disclosure
Foreign account cannot list or revoke the key
Owner revokes key and SQL records inactive state
Forged request role/tier/status and ordinary monthly subscription cannot grant premium API capacity
MFA-required, suspended and banned admins cannot issue keys
findings.limit: No actual third-party integration or production key was used.

findings.before: The recovery test assumed pg_constraint contains only CHECK, foreign-key and primary-key entries; PostgreSQL18 also represents NOT NULL there.
findings.after: Compare restored constraint names, kinds and definitions with the actual source, retain explicit required kinds, and exercise real NOT NULL denial in addition to CHECK and foreign-key denial.
findings.classification: Test compatibility defect, not evidence of data loss in the restore implementation.

Not a full application restart.

remainingAcceptance: Actual deployed admin workflows across all twelve domains are not yet accepted.
Live AI generation, music distribution, marketing delivery, external payments and settlement remain unverified by this pass.
Production runtime restart and deployment rollback are blocked/unexecuted here; logout/login and fresh-process storage recovery do not replace them.
Storage recovery used controlled drained writers and disposable databases, not live Neon, offsite backups, every application table or an RPO/RTO measurement.
Deployed source revision, private-launch governance and monitoring remain unverified; source governance defaults permit ordinary registration.
Replit inspection returned busy/not-submitted; publication status returned found=false with no current status available.
Hosted CI was previously blocked by account billing; this pass claims local checks only.
AGROS task catalogs and release criteria exist in PR210, but default executors/reviewers/acceptance producer remain unconfigured.
